summary: I am a software engineer and UI-focused developer with a passion for slick UI and a knack for design. I have a blend of technical expertise and strong communication and leadership skills. I enjoy building things that solve interesting problems.

experience.description: • Function as a leader by example in continual pursuit of iterative CI/CD development approach•Facilitate growth from a position of leadership of a team of 4 junior developers.• Enhance custom EHR system through frequent 1:1 interaction with internal leadership and stakeholders.

• Design, develop, and maintain internal tools and custom applications using Next.js and TypeScript, including detailed documentation and LMS content.• Engineer web solutions to improve cross-departmental workflows, leveraging custom APIs, React components, and UI libraries for enhanced efficiency.• Automate code translation and data processes, developing secure Next.js endpoints to integrate browser UI with custom scripts.• Deliver specialized training on the Duck Creek platform, focusing on C#, OOP, XML, API consumption, and SQL to equip developers with essential skills.

projects.name: Innovate Portal
projects.description: Participated in building an internal tools portal, integrating AI elements throughout. This included a custom AI chatbot for user support, general staff use, and as a liaison to acclimate new developers into the codebase and development environment to increase efficiency. This was built using Next.js, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS and leveraged the MS Teams tenant for including the custom AI component.

projects.name: DocuVendor
projects.description: Designed and Developed a custom internal training tool that functioned as a static documentation hub for use by the training department to create and maintain training collateral of various media types. This was built with Next.js, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS and included custom APIs that allowed integration into the internal AI chatbot to allow users to query the documentation through the chatbot interface and receive relevant documentation in response.
